top_choice_rationale: P001 credits one coherent achievement, targeted protein degradation by induced proximity, with a ternary-complex mechanism that is a measurable, tunable physical quantity and has been independently confirmed across many groups and ligases. Crews and Deshaies hold the 2001 priority, and Ciulli's VHL ligand chemistry and structural account of cooperativity made it a rational design discipline. The citation is scoped to heterobifunctional degraders, so it does not claim the cereblon glue branch. Clinical payoff is still prospective, but the principle does not depend on an approval. P002 keeps the Crews-Deshaies core but drops Ciulli and pairs it with base editing, an unrelated and less distinct achievement. P003 is mature and cleanly attributed, but it extends the 2010 palladium coupling framework. A prize is still preferable to none.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Stockholm University colleague of Xiaodong Zou, who is not a candidate, and no tie to any proposed laureate
